description: Checked contract for mcp-io's registration surface: the mcpServers entry shape written for every target, and the path-resolution rule per target. A future consumer (e.g. a mcp-io-py port) must reproduce this exactly -- see the okta-auth-rs/okta-auth-py drift lesson in the design doc. Pinned by src/register/tests.rs's `contract` test module: changing this file without updating the real writers (or vice versa) fails that test.

entry.description: The mcpServers entry value mcp-io writes for EVERY target, verified byte-for-byte against a real `claude mcp add-json` invocation (Phase 3 implementation notes).

user.resolution: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.claude.json if $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is set and absolute, else $HOME/.claude.json

project.resolution: ./.mcp.json, resolved relative to the current working directory (project scope)

resolution.linux: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json if $XDG_CONFIG_HOME is set and absolute, else $HOME/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (community build)
